description: This file defines the CoreDataTuner class, which modifies Liquibase change logs to optimize database setup for OpenMRS, including reordering change sets, discarding certain change sets, and updating default user credentials.

classes.name: CoreDataTuner
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractSnapshotTuner to modify Liquibase database change logs for OpenMRS, including reordering change sets and updating user credentials.

methods.name: updateChangeLog
methods.description: Main method that updates the change log document by detaching, reordering change sets, and updating admin user credentials.

methods.name: detachAndCacheChangeSets
methods.description: Removes change sets from the document and caches them for reordering.

methods.name: addChangeSets
methods.description: Re-adds change sets in a specified order, prioritizing certain tables.

methods.name: updateAdminUser
methods.description: Modifies the admin user credentials in the change log.

methods.name: getDatabaseChangeLogElement
methods.description: Retrieves the root databaseChangeLog element from the document.

methods.name: getFirstTableNames
methods.description: Returns the list of table names that should be placed first in the change log.

methods.name: getChangeSetsByTableName
methods.description: Returns the cached change sets mapped by table name.

methods.name: getTableNames
methods.description: Returns the list of table names encountered during processing.
